about_the_game:
FLAIR - THE WORLD REACTS TO YOUR WORDS

A game where the world changes through prompts – your words shape reality.
Welcome to Flair, the first-ever top-down RPG where your imagination literally becomes the game. No more updates for content - here, you create it.

CREATE YOUR REALITY

Write it. Build it. Live it.
In Flair, your words have power. Become anyone - a rockstar, an alien, a president, or something that has never existed before.
Everything you create becomes part of a living, open world - visible to everyone.

A WORLD BUILT BY PLAYERS

The world of Flair grows with every player’s imagination.
Claim your land, build your home, or create entire cities and kingdoms. 
Together, players are shaping an infinite online world that constantly evolves.

Join our Discord! (link in the sidebar)
Get Alpha & Beta access, vote on new features, and be part of building the future of Flair.

FORGE YOUR DESTINY

Create your own weapon - every weapon is unique.
Customize its stats, level it up, and boost its power to match your playstyle.
From a rolling pin to an e-scooter, a butterfly knife, or a purple laser sword – everything you imagine can become a weapon.
With the right combination of weapon and character, true legends are forged.

PLAY. CREATE. EVOLVE.

Team up or compete in PvE and PvP as the world expands with every player’s creation.
The community drives the world forward, one idea at a time.

THE VISION

This isn’t just another game.
Flair marks the beginning of a new era of interactive creativity - 
where every imagination matters, and the world evolves with your ideas.

Wishlist now and join the beginning of gaming history.

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 11 (Big Sur)
  • Processor: ntel Core i3 / Apple M1
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 4000a
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
mac_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: macOS 12 (Monterey)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 / Apple M1/M2
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: AMD Radeon Pro 555X / Apple M1/M2 GPU
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection

Minimum:

  • Processor: Intel Core i3 (or similar)
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 4000 or similar
  • DirectX: Version 11

Recommended:

  • Processor: Intel Core i5 or better
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 660 or AMD Radeon HD 7850
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
